Class KeyVaultSigningKeyProvider

Namespace
NuvTools.Security.Signing.Azure

Signs with an RSA key kept in Azure Key Vault. The private key never leaves the vault: this process holds the public half of each version and asks the vault for every signature.

public class KeyVaultSigningKeyProvider : ISigningKeyProvider, IDisposable

Remarks

Every enabled version of the key that is within its validity period is offered, so tokens signed before a rotation keep validating. A new version starts signing once it has been published for ActivationDelay.

The list of versions is read again every RefreshInterval. When the vault cannot be reached for that, the last list read keeps being served: a rotation noticed late is better than no token at all.

The identity used needs to list and read the key and to sign with it — the Key Vault Crypto User role covers both.
